title: MZ Battle HUD Customizer using WYSIWYG Editor (Lite)

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body:
This thread is about the
Lite
version of this plugin. The lite version is available for free and can be used in any kind of game!
A pro version with an extended feature set is coming soon.
Due to its complexity, I decided to release this plugin first as a "work in progress", so you won't feel too frustrated if anything is missing or not yet working. Don't hesitate to report errors!
Features
Arrange windows as you wish - either fixed by screen coordinates or bound to other windows, or even the battlers (SV only)
Reposition actor-related elements such as faces, names, and gauges
Remove faces
Use custom images as window backgrounds
add Icons to your command windows
Supported Engine(s)
This plugin supports RPG Maker MZ only - an MV version is not planned right now due to code complexity.
Compatibility
I tested it with Visustella Core & Battle Core - the game does not break, but some minor issues may occur.
Licence
The lite version is available for free and can be used in any game project.
Screenshots
Spoiler
Download
Right-click, save as...
https://downloads.aerosys.blog/plugins/MK_UICustomizer_Battle_Lite.js
You need to include the base plugin, too:
[MV & MZ] Custom Main Menu UI using WYSIWYG Editor
What is this Plugin?  This plugin comes packed with a UI tool that lets you customize your game's main menu!    Features  More than 6 premade layout configurations ...or arrange all windows as you wish Choose how your Actors should be rendered: Face, SV Battler, Map Sprite, custom Portrait...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
